text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... thank you so much
for agreeing to this interview.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Not at all, the honor is mine.
...It's the column untangling the history of the Grand Prix for the next school newspaper, right?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If I will suffice,
I shall do my absolute best.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
N-No, I'm truly humbled...!
To have you speak about the Grand Prix races
is an absolute honor...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Especially that historic Arima Kinen...
where she completed a three-peat in the Grand Prix.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Even while dealing with leg concerns,
she emerged victorious after a fierce battle with her generation rival――
The margin over 2nd place was a mere 4 centimeters."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
A dead heat where both sides' pride clashed head-on.
...On that day of the decisive battle,
what thoughts did you carry into the race?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, indeed.
After all, what struck me most strongly was—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Even if it takes everything you have, you want to beat that girl
...is that it?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Precisely because it is a grand stage like the Arima Kinen,
I kept the flame burning in my heart—
to defeat the 'Supreme Commander of Japan' and fulfill my long-cherished wish.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-I see...!
Please tell me more about those feelings.
For example, the night before the Arima Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
T-Thank you so very much!
Every single story was so deeply inspiring...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I got a little carried away talking.
...You have more interviews after this, right?
I'm looking forward to reading your column.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, dear customer.
Today is a super special discount day,
and Golshi-chan will answer anything you ask, you see.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—Or so you thought, but it's an okonomiyaki party timeee!!
I'm having Kansai-style, and you're getting Hiroshima-style!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Okonomiyaki...!?
U-Um, wasn't this supposed to be an interview for the Takarazuka Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(...No, wait. She's a famous Umamusume who
won the Takarazuka Kinen back-to-back...
Could grilling okonomiyaki have some deeper meaning...?!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... Listen closely, young lady. Dough must be made veeeery slowly. Yes, just as delicately as if handling gold—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And from there, BOOOOM!!!
Even if there's gold and silver inside, blast through at top speed!
Grab that treasure with your own hands, brothaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (!? A treasure... and going slow then suddenly speeding up... don't tell me—)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (Even in the Takarazuka Kinen Golshi won back-to-back, she fell behind at the start but forcefully pushed her way to the front! In that case, this must be...!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
U-Um! Does that okonomiyaki
have something to do with
the Takarazuka Kinen race...?!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Amazing... To get to hear such a valuable story.
The history of the Grand Prix feels so vivid now...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I need to stay sharp for this last upcoming interview.
To make it a column that goes down in history...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I refuse.
...I am not in the mood.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer
text_block_list.text:
Pardon the intrusion, Lady Chrono.
We accepted the interview request the other day,
but she says she isn't in the mood today...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(N-No way...! Without Orfe-san's
Arima Kinen, that column won't...!)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—Hmph, you look quite vexed.
In that case... behold the King's mercy.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Entertain me.
...Show me your finest performance."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
E-Entertainment...!?
...U-Understood...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Well then—I'll recreate that famous commentary
from the Arima Kinen you won!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
—Orfevre makes her move from the outside!
Right behind her is Gold Ship, or perhaps Win Variation!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: She broke through, she broke through, broke through, broke through! So strong! Number 6, Orfevre! In the blink of an eye, she has extended her lead—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Orfevre cruises across the finish line in an overwhelming victory!
What incredible strength, completely unchallenged!
This is what racing is all about! An utter triumph for Orfevre—!"

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer
text_block_list.text:
Th-This is...! The race development, the positioning,
even the gate numbers are completely spot-on...!?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I-If you'd like... I can also imitate other commentators' styles. H-How does that sound... !?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"—Heh, hahaha...
I see, I see."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
A faint spark of that day's passion has returned.
……So, what is it you desire?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Thank you very much!
Regarding that "Arima Kinen" where you showed such an overwhelming performance—

One day. Hearing that a new "Idle Thoughts: History Tales"
was published, I read the school newspaper—
choice_data_list: ...Incredible. So this is the history of the Grand Prix...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
N-No... It's all thanks to the cooperation
of such great predecessors like you all.
I was able to write a truly wonderful column.
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to the next Grand Prix race.
I'm really looking forward to the next Grand Prix race!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes, the next Grand Prix is the Takarazuka Kinen... It's a non-standard distance of 2,200 meters, and since it's during the rainy season, the track condition easily deteriorates—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, no one knows who will win until the very end.
...I am certain that this year's Takarazuka Kinen
will be one for the history books as well.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the next Grand Prix is the Arima Kinen...
To overcome those two uphill slopes, lacking either power
or stamina will put victory entirely out of reach—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
And that is why so many dramas were born.
...I am certain this year's Arima Kinen
will be one for the history books as well.
